intro.en: Fuel-system harnesses connect controllers with pump modules, injectors, pressure and temperature sensors, metering valves and related devices. Custom options include tank-module leads, pump branches, gasoline or diesel injector looms, sensor pigtails and repair assemblies. These are electrical components, not fuel hoses or pressure pipes.
intro.zh: 燃油系统线束在车辆控制器、燃油泵模块、喷油器、压力与温度传感器、计量阀及相关接口之间传送电源与控制信号。这个定制小类包括油箱模块引线、外置泵分支、汽油喷油器线束、柴油共轨分支、传感器短引线和维修组件。它是电气布线，不是输送燃油的软管或承压管路。

knowledge.en: Fuel delivery architectures differ across port-injected gasoline, gasoline direct injection and diesel common rail. A matching connector body does not establish the correct pin map, injector driver, pump current, sensor reference or environmental rating. Define each circuit and its installed zone before choosing wire, terminals, sealing and branch protection.
knowledge.zh: 歧管喷射汽油机、汽油直喷和柴油共轨的供油电气架构并不相同。接头外壳能对插，不代表针脚表、喷油驱动、泵电流、传感器参考电压或环境等级正确。选择线材、端子、密封与分支防护前，先定义每条回路及其安装区域。

notes.en: Send vehicle and engine identity, controller family, system voltage, pump and injector part numbers, mating connectors and cavity views, circuit and pin tables, sensor outputs, route dimensions, clips, heat and fuel exposure, sample or drawing, quantity and agreed inspection requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供车辆与发动机身份、控制器家族、系统电压、泵和喷油器料号、对插件与孔位视图、回路及针脚表、传感器输出形式、走线尺寸、卡扣、热与燃油暴露条件、样品或图纸、数量和约定检验要求。

delivery.en: Approved inputs become controlled drawings, a pin and circuit map, BOM, branch datums, termination and protection instructions, labels and inspection criteria. A first article is reviewed for mating, reach, routing and electrical identity before repeat build; powered function, ingress, thermal and chemical tests require separately agreed methods and limits.
delivery.zh: 批准的输入转化为受控图纸、针脚与回路图、物料表、分支基准、端接和防护工艺、标签及检验准则。重复制作前，首件核对对插、可达、走线和电气身份；上电功能、防护、热与化学测试须另行约定方法和限值。

introduction.en: Map the electrical side of fuel delivery
introduction.zh: 先看清供油系统的电气一侧

faq.zh: 燃油系统线束常见问题

subtitle.en: Pump power, injector drivers, sensor signals, fuel-zone materials and first-article control
subtitle.zh: 泵供电、喷油驱动、传感信号、燃油环境用料与首件控制

lead.en: One engine can contain several fuel-related sub-harnesses. The useful starting point is not a universal connector list but a circuit map: which device is powered, measured or switched, where it sits, and what the engine controller expects at that interface.
lead.zh: 一台发动机可能有多根与燃油相关的分线束。起点不是一份通用接头清单，而是回路图：哪个装置需要供电、测量或开关，它装在哪里，发动机控制器又要求接口满足什么条件。

title.zh: 做的是电气组件，不是燃油管路

copy.en: A fuel-system wiring assembly can connect an in-tank pump and level sender, an external pump or filter-module device, injector banks, rail-pressure sensors, fuel-temperature sensors and metering valves. The fuel rail, hoses and pressure seals remain mechanical fluid components. This distinction matters at a quotation stage: electrical continuity and connector fit do not certify pressure containment or fluid tightness. The photographed tank outlet is installation context, not a wiring product.
copy.zh: 燃油系统电气组件可能连接油箱内泵与液位发送器、外置泵或滤清器模块、喷油器组、油轨压力传感器、燃油温度传感器和计量阀。油轨、软管与承压密封仍属于机械流体部件。报价时必须分清这条边界：电气导通与接头对插，并不能证明承压能力或燃油密封性。图中的油箱出口仅说明安装环境，不是线束成品。

copy.en: Mark the controller-side and device-side breakpoints, branch count and service disconnects.
copy.zh: 标明控制器侧与设备侧断开点、分支数和维修断开位置。

copy.en: Electrical testing does not qualify the adjacent fuel plumbing.
copy.zh: 电气检测不替代相邻燃油管路的验证。

title.en: Pump power and sender signals follow different paths
title.zh: 泵供电与液位信号不能混为一路

copy.en: A tank module may combine an electric pump, level sender and sometimes additional sensing or control electronics in one serviceable package. Pump feed, return and protection are selected against operating and start-up current, run length, voltage drop, connector temperature and controller strategy. A sender or low-level sensor needs its specified reference, ground and signal route; do not casually share it with a noisy motor return. Confirm whether the customer needs an external connector lead, a tank-side assembly or both. The cutaway photograph shows a tank module and wiring route as context, not a specified finished assembly.
copy.zh: 油箱模块可能把电动泵、液位发送器，以及其他传感或控制电子件集成在一个可维修单元内。泵的供电、回流与保护，要按工作和起动电流、路径长度、压降、接头温度及控制策略选择；液位或低电平传感器则需要规定的参考、接地与信号路径，不能随意与电机噪声回流共用。还要确认客户需要油箱外部引线、油箱内部组件，还是两者都要。剖面照片展示油箱模块与布线路径，仅作场景参考，并非指定成品组件。

copy.en: Supply and return resistance both affect the pump's available voltage.
copy.zh: 供电与回流电阻都会影响泵端可用电压。

copy.en: Level and pressure readings follow the controller's reference scheme.
copy.zh: 液位与压力读数服从控制器的参考方案。

title.en: Injector branches preserve cylinder order and driver intent
title.zh: 喷油器分支要守住缸序与驱动方式

copy.en: Port-injection and direct-injection systems may use different injectors, drivers, supply arrangements and packaging. A two-pin shape alone cannot identify the ECU output, shared feed, return path or waveform. The harness drawing should specify cylinder assignment, cavity view, terminal system, branch station and orientation at each injector. If a replacement is developed from a sample, wire colors and physical reach help, but controller pin data and the actual engine variant settle the electrical identity. The photo shows an injector's electrical interface rather than a finished Super Smile harness.
copy.zh: 歧管喷射和缸内直喷系统的喷油器、驱动器、供电布置和安装空间可能完全不同。两针外形本身不能识别 ECU 输出、共用供电、回流路径或驱动波形。线束图纸应写清各喷油器的缸号分配、孔位视图、端子体系、分支站位和接口朝向。按旧样开发时，线色与长度只能辅助判断，最终电气身份仍取决于控制器针脚资料和实际发动机变型。照片展示喷油器电气接口，而非超斯迈尔成品线束。

copy.en: A correct-looking branch can still drive the wrong injector if cylinders are crossed.
copy.zh: 分支外观正确，缸号交叉仍会驱动错误喷油器。

copy.en: Do not infer voltage, polarity or pulse behavior from the plug shell.
copy.zh: 不能依据插头外壳推断电压、极性或脉冲行为。

title.zh: 共轨分支必须对应具体控制器

copy.en: Diesel common-rail injector circuits, metering devices and rail sensing sit near high-pressure hardware, heat and vibration. Their electrical driver strategy is not interchangeable with a gasoline injector lead. Depending on the engine, injector actuation may involve voltages and switching behavior beyond ordinary low-voltage sensor wiring; exact limits come from the controller and component documentation. Route electrical branches clear of service access to high-pressure lines, keep the intended shielding or separation, and protect branch exits from engine movement and abrasion. The photographed injector is an example of the device, not a compatible part claim.
copy.zh: 柴油共轨喷油器、计量装置与油轨传感器靠近高压机械部件，也承受热和振动。其电气驱动策略不能与汽油喷油器引线互换。视发动机而定，喷油器驱动的电压和开关行为可能超出一般低压传感器布线范围；具体限值必须来自控制器与元件资料。电气分支应避开高压管路的维修通道，维持既定屏蔽或隔离，并保护分支出口免受发动机运动与磨损。图示喷油器只是器件示例，不构成兼容料号声明。

copy.en: Do not bind the electrical loom into a high-pressure pipe service route.
copy.zh: 不要把电气线束捆入高压管路的维修路径。

copy.en: Injector, rail and metering connections require the approved pin and driver map.
copy.zh: 喷油器、油轨与计量连接须依据批准的针脚和驱动图。

title.en: Pressure and temperature signals need stable references
title.zh: 压力与温度信号需要稳定参考

copy.en: A rail-pressure sensor, low-pressure sensor, fuel-temperature sensor or tank-level sender may use analogue or other controller-defined outputs. Wire count and connector keying are only the beginning: reference voltage, sensor ground, signal type, fault detection and permissible noise belong in the circuit table. Keep sensitive measurement routes away from pumps and switching injector branches where the controller requires it. The pressure gauge in the photo provides a fuel-system context; it is mechanical and should not be mistaken for an electrical pressure transducer supplied with this harness.
copy.zh: 油轨压力、低压压力、燃油温度或油箱液位器件可能采用模拟量或其他由控制器定义的输出。线数与接头防错只是起点，参考电压、传感器地、信号类型、故障检测和允许噪声都应写入回路表。按控制器要求，使敏感测量路径与泵及快速开关的喷油分支保持距离。照片中的压力表仅提供燃油系统场景；它是机械表，不能误认作本线束配套的电气压力变送器。

title.en: Map the signal, not just pins
title.zh: 核对信号，不只核对针位

copy.en: The same cavity count can conceal different reference and output schemes.
copy.zh: 相同孔数也可能对应不同参考和输出方案。

copy.en: Routing and return separation follow controller requirements.
copy.zh: 走线与回流隔离服从控制器要求。

title.en: Select materials for the actual fuel-exposure zone
title.zh: 按真实燃油暴露区域选材

copy.en: Engine heat, splash, fuel vapor, diesel mist, cleaning fluids, abrasion and vibration do not create one universal material specification. Choose conductor section, insulation, sleeve, tape, seals, cavity plugs and backshells for the installed zone and the exact mating connector system. Fuel-resistant claims belong to named material grades and test conditions; an oil-resistant sleeve or a sealed-looking shell is not proof of immersion suitability. Routing, clips, bend relief and distance from hot or sharp parts remain as important as the material datasheet. The pictured pump connector illustrates an electrical interface only.
copy.zh: 发动机热、飞溅、燃油蒸气、柴油油雾、清洗液、磨损与振动，不能归结为一种通用材料规格。导体截面、绝缘、套管、胶带、线封、空孔塞和尾壳都要按安装区域及准确的对插体系选择。耐燃油声明必须对应具体材料牌号和试验条件；所谓耐油套管或看起来密封的外壳，不等于适合浸泡。走线、卡扣、弯曲缓解，以及与热源和锐边的距离，同样重要。图中泵接头仅用于说明电气接口。

copy.en: Splash, vapor, mist and immersion are different selection cases.
copy.zh: 飞溅、蒸气、油雾与浸泡是不同选材情形。

copy.en: Housing, terminal, wire diameter, wire seal and unused-cavity closure must match.
copy.zh: 壳体、端子、线径、线封与未用孔封堵必须匹配。

title.en: From an old sample to a controlled repeatable assembly
title.zh: 从旧样到可重复的受控组件

copy.en: We can scope a complete engine-side fuel branch, a pump-module lead, an injector bank, a sensor pigtail or a replacement service loom. Start with a drawing or sample, then reconcile connector part numbers, cavity view, circuit identity, load, branch dimensions, fasteners and exposure zones against the actual vehicle and controller. A first article checks mating, routing, terminal seating, circuit map and agreed visual points. Production inspection may include continuity and short checks, but functional powered tests, pressure or ingress tests, thermal cycling and chemical resistance need separate procedures, samples and acceptance limits. The service photograph illustrates access constraints, not a company test record.
copy.zh: 项目范围可以是发动机侧完整燃油分支、泵模块引线、喷油器组、传感器短引线或维修替换线束。先从图纸或样品出发，再结合实际车辆和控制器核对连接器料号、孔位视图、回路身份、负载、分支尺寸、固定件和暴露区域。首件核对对插、走线、端子入位、回路映射及约定外观项。批量检验可包含导通和短路检查；上电功能、承压或防护、冷热循环及耐化学性则需要另定程序、样本和验收限值。维修照片仅说明可达性，不是本公司的试验记录。

copy.en: Approved changes update drawing, BOM and test fixture together.
copy.zh: 批准的变更应同步更新图纸、物料表和测试工装。

copy.en: A continuity pass is not a claim of vehicle-level or fluid-system validation.
copy.zh: 导通合格不等于整车或燃油流体系统验证。

q.en: Is a fuel-system harness the same as a fuel line?
q.zh: 燃油系统线束等同于燃油管吗？

a.en: No. The harness carries electrical power and signals to pumps, injectors, valves and sensors. Hoses, rails and pipes carry fuel and require separate fluid-system engineering and verification.
a.zh: 不等同。线束向泵、喷油器、阀和传感器输送电源与信号；软管、油轨和管路输送燃油，需另行开展流体系统设计与验证。

q.en: Can a connector that fits an injector be used directly?
q.zh: 喷油器插头能插上就可以直接用吗？

a.en: No. Confirm the injector and controller part numbers, cavity view, driver strategy, circuit assignment, terminal system and installed environment. A shared shell shape does not prove electrical compatibility.
a.zh: 不能。还需确认喷油器与控制器料号、孔位视图、驱动策略、回路分配、端子体系和安装环境。外壳形状相同不证明电气兼容。

q.en: Does a sealed connector make the whole harness fuel-resistant?
q.zh: 密封接头能让整根线束耐燃油吗？

a.en: No. Fuel exposure must be defined by liquid, vapor or mist, duration and temperature. Wire insulation, seals, protection and the mated connector all need suitable material evidence and an agreed test if a resistance claim is required.
a.zh: 不能。应明确是液体、蒸气还是油雾，以及接触时长和温度。若需耐受声明，线材绝缘、密封、防护及对插连接器均需对应材料证据和约定试验。

q.en: Can you make a replacement from a used vehicle sample?
q.zh: 可以按车辆旧样制作替换件吗？

a.en: A sample helps locate connectors and branches, but repairs, heat damage, hidden wire grades and different engine variants can mislead. Match it to the vehicle, controller and pin documentation before approving a first article.
a.zh: 旧样有助于定位接头和分支，但临时维修、热损伤、隐藏线材牌号与发动机变型可能误导。批准首件前要与车辆、控制器和针脚资料核对。

q.en: What information is needed to quote a fuel-system harness?
q.zh: 燃油系统线束报价需要哪些资料？

a.en: Please send vehicle and engine model, ECU family, pump/injector/sensor references, pin and circuit table, mating connector details, system voltage and loads, route dimensions, exposure zones, sample or drawing, quantity and requested inspection.
a.zh: 请提供车型与发动机型号、ECU 家族、泵／喷油器／传感器资料、针脚与回路表、对插件详情、系统电压及负载、走线尺寸、暴露区域、样品或图纸、数量与所需检验。
